title: Noosa and District Landcare

points: Noosa and District Landcare is the local community group restoring the land and waterways around Noosa.
Between 2022 and 2024 it planted about 133,000 trees over 332 hectares of logged hinterland forest, chosen to bring back the eucalypts koalas feed on.
$1 from every one of our guests goes to Noosa and District Landcare, through Trees for Tourism and Noosa Koala Connect.

sources: Tree planting figures: library/places/koalas.json (Ride Guide koala story). $1 per guest: EO-TR-10 Caring for the place brief. Added 12/11/2026 at Ben's request.
